nodes.description: Update app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx to add a 4th Read tab (newspaper icon) between Learn and Quiz. Create app/(tabs)/Read.tsx with tile-based layout matching existing tab style (tabTileStyles). Tiles: Matra Words, Sentence Reading, Stories. Each tile routes to its respective screen.
nodes.acceptance:

nodes.title: Create progress hooks (useProgress, useCoins, useStreak)
nodes.description: Create app/hooks/useProgress.ts, useCoins.ts, useStreak.ts. useProgress reads/writes level completion data (stars, scores) to AsyncStorage under key 'ira_progress'. useCoins manages coin balance (earn/spend). useStreak tracks daily streak (current, longest, lastPlayedDate). All use AsyncStorage. Data shape matches the spec in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-02-ira-hindi-2nd-standard-levelup-design.md section 3.4.
nodes.acceptance:
- useProgress: getLevel(id), completeLevel(id, stars, score), isLevelUnlocked(id)
- useCoins: balance, earnCoins(amount), spendCoins(amount), canAfford(amount)
- useStreak: currentStreak, longestStreak, checkIn() updates streak
- All persist to AsyncStorage
- Hook returns loading state while reading

nodes.title: Matra Word Reading Levels
nodes.description: 10 progressive matra-based word reading levels with learn and practice phases

nodes.title: Create readingContent.ts with matra word data
nodes.description: Create app/constants/readingContent.ts with matraLevels array. 10 levels, each with: id, matra character, vowel, name, 8-10 words. Each word has: word string, meaning (English), matra highlight indices. No audio require() yet — TTS will be used initially. No image require() yet — will use emoji placeholders. Include unlock logic: level N unlocks after level N-1 completed with 80%+. Level 1 is always unlocked. Reference spec section 2.1 for word lists.
nodes.acceptance:
- 10 matra levels defined (ा through mixed)
- Each level has 8-10 age-appropriate Hindi words
- Each word has: word, meaning, matra highlight info
- Export matraLevels array
- TypeScript types defined for all data shapes

nodes.title: Build MatraLevelScreen with learn and practice phases
nodes.description: Create app/screens/MatraLevelScreen.tsx. Two phases: Learn Phase — full-screen swipeable cards showing each word with matra highlighted in color, meaning below, tap to hear (react-native-tts). Practice Phase — audio plays a word, 4 choices displayed, tap correct one. Track score. On completion show star rating (0-3 stars based on accuracy: <50%=0, 50-69%=1, 70-89%=2, 90-100%=3). Save progress via useProgress hook. Award coins via useCoins (5 per star). Use react-native-gesture-handler for swipe, react-native-reanimated for card transitions.
nodes.acceptance:
- Learn phase: swipeable word cards with matra highlighting and TTS audio
- Practice phase: listen-and-choose quiz with 4 options, minimum 5 questions
- Star rating (0-3) displayed on completion with animation
- Progress saved to AsyncStorage via useProgress
- Coins awarded (5 per star)
- 80%+ accuracy unlocks next level
- Can replay for better score

nodes.title: Build Matra Level Selection screen
nodes.description: Create app/screens/MatraLevelListScreen.tsx. Shows all 10 levels as a scrollable list/grid. Each level card shows: level number, matra name (e.g. 'आ की मात्रा'), star rating if completed, lock icon if locked. Tapping unlocked level navigates to MatraLevelScreen with level id as param. Uses useProgress to determine unlock state and star ratings. Locked levels show a subtle lock overlay. Use Reanimated for lock-to-unlock animation when a level becomes available.
nodes.acceptance:
- 10 level cards displayed in scrollable grid
- Completed levels show star rating
- Locked levels show lock icon, not tappable
- Unlocked levels navigate to MatraLevelScreen
- Visual distinction between locked/unlocked/completed states

nodes.title: Animated Mascot & Confetti
nodes.description: SVG unicorn mascot with Reanimated animations and confetti particle system

nodes.title: Create SVG Mascot component with animations
nodes.description: Create components/Mascot.tsx. SVG unicorn using react-native-svg with separate groups for head, body, horn, mane, eyes, mouth. Accept a 'mood' prop: 'idle' | 'happy' | 'sad' | 'celebrate'. Idle: gentle floating via withRepeat + withSequence on translateY. Happy: spring jump + sparkle. Sad: head tilt rotation. Celebrate: side-to-side dance. All animations via react-native-reanimated useSharedValue/useAnimatedStyle. Keep SVG simple — stylized/cute, not detailed. Accept a 'size' prop for different contexts (small badge vs large avatar screen).
nodes.acceptance:
- SVG unicorn renders correctly on Android
- 4 mood animations: idle (floating), happy (jump), sad (tilt), celebrate (dance)
- Accepts size prop (small/medium/large)
- Smooth 60fps animations via Reanimated
- No external image assets — pure SVG paths

nodes.title: Create Confetti particle component
nodes.description: Create components/Confetti.tsx. 20-30 SVG particles (circles and small rects) that burst from top of screen. Each particle: random color from cheerful palette, random initial X position, gravity-based Y animation (withTiming with easing), random horizontal drift, fade out near bottom. Expose via ref: confettiRef.current.burst(). Duration ~2 seconds. Uses react-native-reanimated shared values for all particle positions. Renders as an absolute-positioned overlay.
nodes.acceptance:
- Burst triggered via ref
- 20-30 colorful particles animate with gravity
- Particles fade out, animation completes in ~2 seconds
- Absolute positioned overlay, doesn't affect layout
- Performant (no JS-driven frame-by-frame)

nodes.title: Create StarRating animated component
nodes.description: Create components/StarRating.tsx. Displays 3 stars. Accept 'stars' prop (0-3). When stars prop changes, animate each star sequentially: scale from 0 to 1 with spring + rotate, filled stars in gold, empty stars in gray outline. Use Reanimated withDelay + withSpring for staggered fill animation.
nodes.acceptance:
- 3 stars displayed
- Stars animate in sequence when rating changes
- Gold fill for earned, gray outline for empty
- Spring animation with slight overshoot
- Works with 0, 1, 2, or 3 stars

nodes.title: Create MascotBadge floating component
nodes.description: Create components/MascotBadge.tsx. Small floating badge in top-right corner showing mini mascot + current streak count. Tapping navigates to AvatarScreen. Uses useStreak hook for streak count. Position: absolute, top-right with safe area inset. Shows a small fire emoji next to streak number when streak >= 3. Subtle idle bounce animation on the mascot.
nodes.acceptance:
- Floating badge visible on all tab screens
- Shows mini mascot + streak count
- Tap navigates to AvatarScreen
- Respects safe area insets
- Streak fire indicator at 3+ days

nodes.title: Build AvatarScreen with shop and equip

nodes.title: Sentence Reading
nodes.description: Sentence reading with word-by-word karaoke highlight and comprehension questions

nodes.title: Create KaraokeText component
nodes.description: Create components/KaraokeText.tsx. Renders a sentence as a row of tappable word blocks. When playing audio, highlights words sequentially using Reanimated color interpolation (gray -> active color -> gray). Tap individual word: speak it via TTS + highlight it. Accept props: words array, onWordTap callback, isPlaying boolean, activeWordIndex. Use useAnimatedStyle for smooth color transitions. Words should wrap naturally on multiple lines.
nodes.acceptance:
- Sentence renders as tappable word blocks
- Sequential highlight during audio playback
- Tap single word to hear it via TTS
- Smooth color transitions via Reanimated
- Wraps correctly on small screens

nodes.title: Add sentence data to readingContent.ts
nodes.description: Add sentences export to app/constants/readingContent.ts. Two groups (A and B). Group A: 5 simple 3-4 word sentences. Group B: 5 longer 5-6 word sentences. Each sentence has: text, words array, comprehension question (text + 3 options + correct answer index). Group A unlocks after matra level 5 (ऊ). Group B unlocks after completing Group A. Use device TTS for audio (no pre-generated files yet).
nodes.acceptance:

- Each sentence has words array and comprehension Q&A
- Sentences use vocabulary appropriate for 2nd standard

- Unlock conditions specified in data

nodes.title: Build SentenceReadingScreen

Completing all sentences in a group: award coins (10), unlock next group. Use useProgress to check unlock state and save completion. Mascot reactions on correct/wrong answers.
nodes.acceptance:

- KaraokeText displays each sentence with tap-to-hear words
- Speaker button plays full sentence

nodes.title: Implement Word Builder game
nodes.description: Replace the stub in app/screens/WordBuilderScreen.tsx. Show a target word (text + TTS audio), display its constituent letters/matras as scrambled draggable tiles at bottom. User drags tiles into correct order in slots at top. Use react-native-gesture-handler PanGesture for drag, Reanimated for snap-to-slot animations. Pull words from matraLevels in readingContent.ts (only from completed levels). Correct completion: confetti + coins (5). Wrong order: tiles shake and reset. 5 words per round.
nodes.acceptance:
- Target word shown with audio
- Letters displayed as draggable tiles
- Drag and drop into order slots
- Snap animation when placed correctly
- Shake and reset on wrong placement
- Confetti on correct word completion
- 5 words per round, coins awarded
- Only uses words from completed matra levels
